subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should this stack layer land with the production Gateway admission change and additive QA runner contract included, or should those runtime changes be separated before authorizing the dependency graph?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but repository policy and the stated QA-only scope do not determine whether maintainers intend to couple production restart semantics and new shared plugin contracts to this large migration.

options.title: Split production runtime change
options.body: Extract the Gateway admission change into a focused PR with restart/drain proof, then authorize and land the QA migration dependency transfer separately.

options.title: Approve the coupled layer
options.body: Keep the changes together only after an owner confirms the coupling, focused Gateway availability proof is accepted, and an administrator or security reviewer authorizes the exact dependency head.

options.title: Pause the migration stack
options.body: Hold this PR and its successor until the permanent QA runner API and temporary qa-matrix shim ownership are agreed.

recommendation.title: Split production runtime change
recommendation.body: Extract the Gateway admission change into a focused PR with restart/drain proof, then authorize and land the QA migration dependency transfer separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the stacked migration and merged predecessor, so they are best positioned to explain whether the Gateway and QA runner changes are inseparable; final dependency authorization still requires an administrator or security reviewer.
